title: High-altitude airports
statementMd:
List airports with elevation above 1,000 feet, highest first.

Expected columns: `code`, `city`, `elevation_ft`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT code, city, elevation_ft FROM airports WHERE elevation_ft > 1000 ORDER BY elevation_ft DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
